info.name: HRMS API - Enterprise Edition
info.description:
Production-grade API collection for the HRMS backend.

### Features:
- **Automated Token Management:** Logging in automatically sets the `{{accessToken}}` and `{{refreshToken}}` for the entire collection.
- **Inherited Authorization:** All protected folders automatically inherit the Bearer token—no need to set headers manually.
- **Standardized Responses:** Every endpoint follows a strict `{ success, message, data, meta }` format.

item.name: 05. Departments
item.description: Organization structure management. Requires `DEPARTMENT_*` permissions. Only `HEAD_OF_HR` can delete.

request.description: Requires `DEPARTMENT_CREATE` permission. Name and code must be unique. Code must be uppercase alphanumeric.

Requires `HEAD_OF_HR` role. Cannot delete departments that have positions or workforce requests.

item.name: 06. Positions
item.description: Position management within departments. Requires `POSITION_*` permissions. Only `HEAD_OF_HR` can delete.

request.description: Requires `POSITION_CREATE` permission. Department must exist and be ACTIVE. Code must be unique. salaryMax must be >= salaryMin. Employment types: FULL_TIME, PART_TIME, CONTRACT, INTERNSHIP.

Requires `POSITION_UPDATE` permission. All fields are optional. Statuses: OPEN, CLOSED, FROZEN.
Requires `HEAD_OF_HR` role. Cannot delete positions that have workforce requests.

item.name: 07. Workforce Requests
item.description:
Workforce planning workflow. HR creates requests → submits → HEAD_OF_HR approves/rejects.

### Workflow:
`DRAFT` → `PENDING_APPROVAL` (submit) → `APPROVED` or `REJECTED` (HEAD_OF_HR only)

Requests can be cancelled from DRAFT or PENDING_APPROVAL states.

request.description: Requires `WORKFORCE_CREATE` permission. Creates a new request in DRAFT status. Department must be ACTIVE, position must be OPEN and belong to the specified department. Headcount must be a positive integer.

query.description: Filter: DRAFT, SUBMITTED, PENDING_APPROVAL, APPROVED, REJECTED, CANCELLED

request.description: Requires `WORKFORCE_READ` permission. Returns requests with department, position, and requester info.
Requires `WORKFORCE_READ` permission. Returns full request details with department, position, requester, approver, and rejector info.
Requires `WORKFORCE_CREATE` permission. Only DRAFT requests can be edited.
Requires `WORKFORCE_CREATE` permission. Only DRAFT requests can be deleted.
Requires `WORKFORCE_CREATE` permission. Transitions from DRAFT → PENDING_APPROVAL. Only DRAFT requests can be submitted.
Requires `HEAD_OF_HR` role. Transitions from PENDING_APPROVAL → APPROVED. Records approver and timestamp.
Requires `HEAD_OF_HR` role. Transitions from PENDING_APPROVAL → REJECTED. Rejection reason is required.
Requires `WORKFORCE_CREATE` permission. Can cancel DRAFT or PENDING_APPROVAL requests. Cannot cancel APPROVED or REJECTED requests.
